title: Convoy Shadow
summary: A Guild grain wagon crawls the east road at half a snail's pace, and the dunes have opinions about slow freight. Ride shotgun — keep the wagon in sight from the exchange to the Slick Mile.

objectives.label: Escort the grain wagon — stay within 100m
Collect the manifest wax at the Slick Mile

offer.text: Grain wagon, east road, no brakes worth mentioning. The driver swears the dunes are 'giving him a look'. Shadow him to the Slick Mile and don't lose sight of the rig — the Guild counts escorts that actually escort.

accept.text: He's rolling out of the exchange now. Wagon's the one that smells like bread and fear.
Convoy shadow. Slow hours, honest credits. My favourite kind of lie.

complete.text: Wagon made it with all four skids and most of the driver's nerves. The Guild notes the miles, courier.
